english.note: Use 病 as the all-purpose noun for a physical disease or illness in people, animals, or plants.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an illness, disease, or generally being in bad health.
This is the all-purpose rendering for illness or the state of being sick.
This is the all-purpose choice for a physical illness or disease.
Use this everyday broad medical noun for a physical or mental condition rather than a technical diagnosis.
Use 病 when condition means an illness or abnormal health problem itself, rather than the patient's current status.
